system.description:
The Maidens gave their Chosen a frightening authority over spirits. When a Sidereal activates Terminal Sanction against a present god or elemental, the player rolls (Charisma + Bureaucracy) against a difficulty of the targeted spirit's Essence. Whether this roll succeeds or fails, the spirit must materialize before the Sidereal and remain solid until the end of the scene. If the roll does succeed, the spirit has even more reason to fear the Sidereal. Should the spirit "die" in that scene, the Sidereal has four choices: � The Sidereal can destroy the spirit. � He could bind the spirit to his service--either one task of indefinite duration or general obedience for one year and one day. � He can bind the spirit's Essence into an object, creating an artifact rated at half the spirit's Essence (round up). The Storyteller designs the artifact, based on the powers of the spirit. The artifact lasts only a year and a day, however, before the spirit goes free. � If nothing else, the Sidereal can simply let the spirit reform in its sanctum, knowing full well what the Sidereal could have done to it. Thanks to the terms of the Yozis' surrender, this Charm also works against demons of every Circle and adds a number of automatic successes on the (Charisma + Bureaucracy) roll against them equal to the Sidereal's Essence. This gives Sidereals a second chance to control demons that escape control.

Scroll of Errata: This Charm has a range of (Essence × 10) yards. Activation inflicts an unblockable and undodgeable unnatural Compulsion to materialize; the target is made aware of the Exalt's presence and distance. Binding spirits is an irresistible unnatural Servitude. When used to bind demons, it is identical to sorcerous binding, preventing other bindings of the same demon. With a Bureaucracy 5+, Essence 4+ repurchase, adding +4m allows compelling up to 10 spirits of a specific kind to materialize, and dooms them in defeat if the roll succeeds;

are delineated by type (elemental, god, demon) and Heaven-employment status. A third purchase at Bureaucracy and Essence 6+ allows adding another +4m to sanction up to (Essence ÷ 2) Magnitude spirits at once.
